title: Is there a way to indicate what character is about to be hit?

posts.author: mol10jelly
posts.body:
I've been using RPGMaker MV for years but I'm not all too familiar with the text codes. Say that a slime is about to poison a party member. Is there a way to make the message something like (Slime) poisons [Party Member].
As in, "Slime throws poison on Honeycherry"
I know the text afterwards will indicate who's affected afterwards anyway, I'm just curious.
I'm not using any battle/combat plugins. Any ideas?

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
Good luck. I have been searching for something like this for VX Ace for pretty much ever since I got into RPG Maker, and all Google searches return nothing, no matter how I word it. I know that you are asking for MV, but nothing comes up for any engine.
I've requested a script to be made that displays who is being targeted on here a few times, and nobody seems interested in making one.
I am actually quite surprised that this has not been done yet on any engine. Makes me wonder if it is even possible.
I hope you get your answer.

posts.author: Showsni
posts.body:
I'm not sure exactly what point the enemy chooses its target; maybe it only does it when it's attacking? There's some discussion here:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...script-code-for-enemy-target-selection.98839/
about how the code works, it seems. I think the enemies choose what actions to take beforehand, as I have seen plugins that will show what skill an enemy is about to use (like this one:
https://plugin.fungamemake.com/archives/2373
